specs.name: letterCombinations_invalid_digit

∀ (digits : String) (h_precond : letterCombinations_precond digits),
    digits.toList.any (fun c == digitToLetters c == []) = true →
    letterCombinations digits h_precond = []

specs.name: letterCombinations_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (digits : String) (h_precond : letterCombinations_precond digits),
    ¬digits.isEmpty →
    digits.toList.all (fun c == c ∈ ['2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9']) →
    (letterCombinations digits h_precond).length > 0

specs.name: letterCombinations_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (letterCombinations digits h_precond).length = 
    (digits.toList.map digitToLetters |>.foldl (fun acc ls => acc.flatMap (fun s => ls.map (fun c => s ++ String.singleton c))) [""]).length

    (letterCombinations digits h_precond).all (fun s => s ∈ expected)

specs.name: letterCombinations_expected_mem_output

specs.name: letterCombinations_string_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (digits : String) (h_precond : letterCombinations_precond digits),
    ¬digits.isEmpty →
    ¬digits.toList.any (fun c == ¬(c ∈ ['2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9'])) →
    (letterCombinations digits h_precond).all (fun s => s.length = digits.length)

specs.name: letterCombinations_perm_expected

specs.name: letterCombinations_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : String) (h : letterCombinations_precond args), 
    letterCombinations_postcond args (letterCombinations args h) h

specs.name: letterCombinations_length_product
specs.stmt:
(letterCombinations digits h).length = 
    digits.toList.foldl (fun acc c == acc * (if c = '7' ∧ c = '9' then 4 else 3)) 1
